name: Timeline vertical
summary: Vertical timeline: a line draws top to bottom, with dates on the left and event cards on the right.

params.name: at
params.note: start as a fraction of the shot (0..1)

params.name: color
params.note: accent override; dots use the style's series colours

params.name: dates
params.note: up to 6 dates, shown on the left

params.name: events
params.note: up to 6 event texts, one per card

author: krakujs
